price_value.rationale: The $27,850 ask is well above the $15,848-$19,856 fair value band. A comparable 2012 Luxury at 118k sold for $17,500 in Orange, CA. Tasteful accessories add modest value at most under the buyer's capability rules.

mission_fit.rationale: The car supplies capability the RX lacks: body-on-frame, full-time 4WD, a platform roof rack suited to a rooftop tent, and a modest quality lift and A/T tires. Accessories do not substitute for records.

logistics.rationale: San Diego is a moderate distance with an easy one-way fly-and-drive. It is a CA-registered car and the seller offers viewings. PPI access is not explicitly confirmed, and a smog certificate is required from the seller.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: This is a Luxury trim in burgundy over ivory with a coherent, reputable-brand overland setup (OME, Method, Nitto, platform rack). It is a pleasant but typical modified example. Stickers on the rear side windows are a minor cosmetic item.

seller_questions: What is the VIN, and can you send a current Carfax/AutoCheck?
Can you send the service records you mentioned, with dates and mileages for transmission, transfer case, differential and coolant service?
Has the secondary air injection pump or valve ever been replaced, or has a P2440/P2442 code ever appeared? Please include invoices.
Does this truck have KDSS? If so, was it re-centered after the OME lift, and by whom? Please share the invoice.
Which OME kit (part numbers, lift height) was installed, when, at what mileage, and was an alignment done afterwards?
What are the DOT date codes and size of the Nitto tires?
Can you send a photo of the dash at ignition-on before start, and a cold-start video from fully cold?
Can you send photos of the frame rails, rear crossmember, rear differential and the top of the engine valley area from underneath?
Has the truck towed anything or been used off-road on trails? If so, what kind?
How long have you owned it, and how many owners are on the title?
Will you provide a current smog certificate, and allow a PPI at an independent Toyota/Lexus shop before any deposit?
ppi_focus: Full OBD scan including pending and history codes, with focus on P2440/P2442/P2443 and air pump function
KDSS: confirm whether fitted; check cylinders, lines and accumulator for leaks; measure static lean side to side
1UR-FE valley plate coolant seep (rear of the intake/V) and timing cover oil seepage
Lift install quality: CV boot condition, upper control arm angles, ball joints, alignment, brake line slack
Frame rails, rear crossmember, spare-tire area and hitch for rust, damage or towing wear
Transfer case operation, center diff lock, and fluid condition in transmission, transfer case and diffs
Front shock and strut condition (corrosion observed), bushings and sway-bar links
Roof rack mounting points and roof for leaks or stress around the rack feet and sunroof drains
Tire date codes, even wear and spare match
what_would_change_verdict: A substantial price reduction toward the fair value band would materially improve the value case.
A VIN, a clean history report and receipts covering SAI, KDSS and fluid service would raise documentation.
A clean PPI with no SAI codes, no KDSS leaks and a dry valley plate would raise condition.
Evidence of SAI codes, KDSS leaks, a poorly done lift or towing/off-road abuse would move it down.
evidence.mission_note: This fits the capability branch: body-on-frame, full-time 4WD, and a roof rack ready for a rooftop tent, which the RX cannot offer. The aftermarket build is a modest plus only, and the case rests on records and inspection, which are absent so far.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a burgundy-over-ivory GX460 with a pre-2014 face, Luxury-style interior trim, an OME lift, Method wheels, Nitto A/T tires and a platform roof rack, all visible in the photos. Photos show a clean interior with light bolster wear, a tidy engine bay, and only light surface corrosion on front underbody hardware and shock bodies. No VIN, history report or service records are provided, so title, accident history, ownership and mileage rest on seller statements. The model-critical items are open: secondary air injection history, KDSS presence and status after the lift, and frame condition beyond the front underside. The $27,850 ask sits well above the mileage-adjusted fair value band of $15,848-$19,856. A comparable 2012 Luxury at 118k sold for $17,500 in Southern California. The seller offers service history, more photos and a test drive, so the documentation gap can be tested.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the offered service records (with SAI and KDSS specifics), tire date codes and frame photos, and confirm a PPI at a San Diego Toyota/Lexus independent before any travel or deposit.
